phase: Phase 30: Ultra-Low Latency BLE MTU Frame Packing & Interleaved Diversity

stories.title: Multiplatform BLE ATT MTU Frame Aggregator & Sub-Packet Framer
stories.description: Implement BleMtuAggregator.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ to pack multiple 20ms compressed voice/control frames into a single negotiated 247-byte BLE ATT MTU payload with compact 2-byte frame headers, dynamic flush timeout, and pure Kotlin memory efficiency (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Packs 2-4 compressed audio frames up to target negotiated MTU limit (default 247 bytes, safe fallback 185 bytes)
Enforces max hold flush delay (<= 20ms) to ensure low mouth-to-ear latency
Compact 2-byte sub-frame header encoding frame length and packet type discriminator

stories.title: Time-Diversity Block Interleaver & Playout De-jittering Unpacker
stories.description: Implement BleFrameInterleaver.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ to perform matrix block interleaving across consecutive MTU packets, dispersing burst radio dropouts across disjoint time slots to maximize FEC and PLC recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Disperses adjacent audio frames across M consecutive MTU packets using deterministic (M x N) block interleaving
Unpacker reassembles frames in strict sequence order with bounded de-jitter window
Seamless pass-through of high-priority emergency SOS frames bypassing interleaving delay

stories.title: Transport Dynamic MTU Negotiation & Cockpit Packing Telemetry Wiring
stories.description: Integrate BleMtuAggregator and BleFrameInterleaver into AudioEngine.kt, IntercomHardwareBridge.kt, AndroidPlatformBridge.kt, and IntercomBridge.kt (iOS Swift). Expose active negotiated MTU and packing efficiency percentage to MainCockpitScreen.kt and TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt.
acceptanceCriteria: AndroidPlatformBridge initiates requestMtu(247) and handles onMtuChanged
iOS IntercomBridge binds CoreBluetooth maximumWriteValueLength (typically 185 bytes)
Exposes live MTU packing metrics (active MTU, packed frames/pkt, packing efficiency %) to UI state
Displays MTU pill in TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt with real-time stats

stories.title: 16-Node High-Throughput MTU Packing & Burst Loss Simulation Test
stories.description: Implement BleMtuPackingSimulationTest.kt validating a 16-node convoy under heavy audio transmission. Simulates RF burst dropouts, verifies > 50% reduction in transmitted packet overhead, sub-60ms mouth-to-ear latency, and 100% voice reconstruction when combined with Sprint 34 FEC/PLC.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 16 nodes transmitting packed audio frames across lossy BLE mesh
Verifies >= 50% fewer RF packets transmitted per minute compared to single-frame-per-packet
Confirms end-to-end voice recovery under 25% burst packet loss with de-interleaving + FEC
All tests pass cleanly in ./gradlew test
